steps.message:
Implemented the Express 5 type compatibility fix.

Changed:
- Added [src/express-compat.ts](/app/src/express-compat.ts:1) to preserve Express 4-style route handler return typing, so handlers returning `res.send()` / `res.end()` still typecheck.
- Imported that compatibility module from [src/index.ts](/app/src/index.ts:1) so it is emitted and included for package consumers.
- Updated Express handlers in [src/server/server.ts](/app/src/server/server.ts:60) and [src/apps/setup.ts](/app/src/apps/setup.ts:160) to avoid returning response objects.
- Wrapped Octokit’s webhook middleware so its `Promise<boolean>` return type fits Express 5’s stricter handler signature.

- `npm run lint` passed.
